documentation: Thresholds reproduce AGENTS.md lines 210-214 exactly and are internal and conservative:
they protect the shared host, they are not a budget to spend up to.
The three observation values with no code default (sampleFreshnessMs, healthLatencyMs,
oomRecentWindowMs) are deliberately absent from digitalocean-production: what counts as abnormal
latency, how long an OOM stays recent and how old a sample may be on that host are the
owner's call. While they are absent the policy answers policy-unconfigured and the gate stays
closed, which is the fail-closed behaviour the section demands. Do not invent values here.

isolated-ci.description: Disposable CI runner. Values exist so the gate can be proven end to end against a real Linux /proc; they describe a runner, never the shared VPS.

local-dev.description: Developer machine running the Compose workflow; nothing else on the host is protected.

digitalocean-production.description: DigitalOcean production only. sampleFreshnessMs, healthLatencyMs and oomRecentWindowMs are intentionally absent: until the owner sets them the policy answers policy-unconfigured and every phase is closed.
